sources.title: Amid / Ghorbanzadeh dictionary: چست
sources.observation: An established adjective for brisk/nimble activity; not an insect noun or species.

sources.title: Dehkhoda dictionary: چست

sources.observation: The dictionary opposes this active/brisk sense to laziness or sluggishness. Search-result entry retrieved; direct reopen cache miss, not fabricated fetch success.

authorInference: In this insect tableau čost conveys brisk busy activity, rather than a new anatomical ability. This is contextual literary judgment, not a dictionary claim that every use of busy means čost. Independent semantic/native judgment of this exact fit remains required.
